parameters.name: SAMPRATE
parameters.help: Desired output sample rate in milliseconds.  This may be larger or smaller than the input sample rate.

parameters.name: ALIAS
parameters.help: Specify whether to apply an anti-alias filter before the data is resampled. If the sampling interval is decreasing, the filter will not be applied.

parameters.name: FIDELITY
parameters.help: Specify whether to use a high-fidelity filter 'YES' or a low-fidelity filter 'NO'.

parameters.name: PHASE
parameters.prompt: Use a zero phase Anti-Alias filter?
parameters.help: Specify whether to use a zero phase filter 'YES' or a minimum phase filter 'NO'.

parameters.name: TIMEDLAY
parameters.help: Specify 'YES' to remove the bulk time delay of the minimum phase filter.

parameters.name: REMUTE
parameters.help: Trace mutes (such as first break suppression mutes) may be re-applied after filtering.
